lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for most categories, as few kinds of change have at least two tests that agree after noise correction.
Home new_flow and finish redesign changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Home wait_info, sign_in hint, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, and adoption new_flow produced winning tests, though non-winning tests in these categories showed no clear effect.
Sign_in reorder changes caused negative effects or showed no clear effect across tests.
Early predictions (Rounds 1 and 2) were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results.
Round 3 predictions were too low for winning changes, underestimating sign_in hint and choose_path copy tests.

candidates.title: Two Column Path Option Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen into a two-column layout comparing instant pet adoption against custom pet creation side-by-side.
candidates.why: choose_path has a high mean time (514s) and 16.5% drop-off; choose_path redesigns showed winning results in previous testing.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Meet Your Desktop Companion

path_options.text: Select Quick Adopt or Custom Pet Creation

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Sign In Account Persistence Safety Hint
candidates.change: Display a helpful hint on the sign_in screen explaining that authenticating protects pet progress from resetting on app launch.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in hints have proven effective.

sign_in.hint: Signing in saves your desktop pet state so your companion never resets when restarting the app.

guard.reason: Adds a clear persistence hint to the sign-in screen within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: High confidence from historical sign_in hint wins (+1.3%) and strong support email evidence.

candidates.title: Pet Personality Quiz Customization Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive personality quiz checklist component to the adoption certificate step to let users customize pet traits.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 30.5% drop-off rate, and past adoption new_flow changes produced winning tests.

components.text: Select pet traits: Energetic, Calm, Playful

guard.reason: Adds a customization component to adoption certificate without removing required elements.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step drops 30.5% of users; past new_flow tests were positive but flow addition has high implementation cost.

candidates.title: Desk Pet Creation Activity Stream Status
candidates.change: Show dynamic activity status hints and time estimates on the waiting screen during pet generation.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean wait time (2336s), and wait_info changes have strong historical evidence.

waiting.hint: Your desktop companion is learning its first behaviors... Almost ready!

guard.reason: Provides dynamic activity status and real wait estimate on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses massive 2336s wait time with a proven change type (+2.3% historical lift).

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Interaction Onboarding Screen
candidates.change: Add a new final onboarding screen introducing desktop pet shortcuts and behavior controls right after home welcome.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted confusion on controlling or hiding the pet, and finish step drops 35.2%.

home_intro.headline: Welcome your new desktop pet companion!

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_pet_controls']

candidates.title: Instant Companion Vs Custom Creation Copy Update
candidates.change: Update choose_path body text to clearly contrast instant adoption vs custom creation duration.
candidates.why: choose_path copy edits previously resulted in test wins and clarify expectations quickly.

choose_path.body: Pick Instant Adoption to get your companion in 10 seconds, or Custom Pet to design a unique pet.

guard.reason: Updates choose_path copy accurately contrasting path durations without pricing or false urgency.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak backed by 3 consistent winning tests (+2.6% average lift).

candidates.title: Compact Sign In Credentials Layout
candidates.change: Switch sign_in screen to a compact layout paired with clear account retention messaging.
candidates.why: Sign in step has 18.6% drop-off and 567s mean time; compact design reduces visual friction.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Retain Your Desktop Companion

guard.reason: Redesigns sign-in screen layout while preserving sign-in functionality.

candidates.score_note: Sign in loses 18.6% of users; layout change had +3.5% in 1 test but lacks repeated evidence.

candidates.title: Grid Layout Pet Companion Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign pick_friend with a grid layout displaying styled companion cards for faster choice.
candidates.why: Adoption stage is the largest drop-off barrier (69.5% conversion) taking a median of 89 seconds.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Launch Notification Alert
candidates.change: Enable system tray notification toggle on the waiting screen to alert users when companion setup finishes.
candidates.why: Home wait time mean is 2336s, indicating users tab away or leave the computer during pet creation.

waiting.hint: We will send a desktop notification as soon as your pet is ready to play!

guard.reason: Enables notification option on the waiting screen for when pet setup finishes.

candidates.score_note: Targeting high idle wait time, but notification on home step is unproven empirically.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Tray Shortcut Hint
candidates.change: Add a desktop system tray hint to home_intro explaining how to show, hide, or talk to the pet anytime.
candidates.why: Support mails explicitly mentioned post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding and controlling desktop pets.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Click the system tray icon anytime to bring your pet to the front or hide it.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful shortcut hint to home_intro.

candidates.score_note: Addressed by emails, but historical finish hint changes showed negative lift (-2.2%).

lessons_next: Evidence remains thin for categories with only a single test.
sign_in hint changes have proven helpful with multiple winning tests, though some showed no clear effect.
home wait_info, choose_path copy, and adoption new_flow produced winning changes, though most tests in these categories showed no clear effect.
home new_flow, finish redesign, and finish hint changes consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Early predictions in Rounds 1 and 2 were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results.
Round 3 predictions were too low for winning changes, underestimating sign_in hint and choose_path copy tests.
